name: The Farstriders
inspire: Immediately after a friendly fighter's second Attack in the same phase and a different weapon was picked for those Attacks, Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Vanguard
reactions.trigger: Use this immediately after an Inspired vulnerable friendly fighter in enemy territory used a Core ability.
reactions.rulesText:
Pick one:

- Uninspire and heal that fighter. For the rest of the battle round, this fighter cannot be healed or Inspired.

- Pick an enemy fighter within 3 hexes of this fighter and roll a number of Attack dice equal to the battle round. On a roll of {icon:hammer} or {icon:crit}, inflict 1 damage on that fighter.

abilities.name: Ranger Elite
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step.
abilities.flavorText: To deliver the killing blow, first a hunter must find the right position...
abilities.rulesText: Push each friendly fighter a number of hexes equal to the battle round. Those pushes must end in enemy territory. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Forward the Vanguard!
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step.
abilities.flavorText: To fight in the Vanguard Chamber demands a courageous and adventurous spirit indeed.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter that is not in enemy territory and not adjacent to any enemy fighters. That friendly fighter can Move. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Behind Enemy Lines
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step.
abilities.flavorText: Like all Vanguard warriors, the Farstriders are well used to fighting in hostile conditions and without support.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a damaged friendly fighter in enemy territory. Give that fighter a Guard token. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Three Stormcast Vanguard rangers with modest durability and average Move, each carrying both a melee and a ranged weapon. They Inspire by attacking twice in a phase with different weapons, mixing shots and strikes to unlock extra dice, Cleave and Grievous. Once-per-game pushes and Moves throw the trio deep into enemy territory, where Guard tokens, healing and chip damage reward fighting behind enemy lines. The warband wins by striking early from range, then pressing aggressively into the opponent's half to pick off targets and hold their objectives.
